widgets.name: Camera Feed
widgets.description: A live view from a camera on the active craft. Pick which camera to watch, step to the next or previous one, and aim and zoom the ones that can.

actions.label: Next camera
actions.description: Switch to the next available camera, persisting the choice to the widget config (wraps round at the end of the list).

actions.label: Previous camera
actions.description: Switch to the previous available camera (wraps round).

actions.label: Zoom in
actions.description: Held: zooms in, field of view falling. Live, this drives the camera; above the staged delay threshold it turns the staged zoom wheel at 30 degrees per second and sends nothing until the commit.

actions.label: Zoom out
actions.description: Held: zooms out, field of view rising. Live, this drives the camera; above the staged delay threshold it turns the staged zoom wheel at 30 degrees per second and sends nothing until the commit.

actions.label: Pan yaw axis
actions.description: Analog yaw rate, -1..1. Positive = right. Live, this is the camera's pan rate at up to its max pan speed; above the staged delay threshold it turns the staged yaw wheel at up to 30 degrees per second, clamped to the camera's yaw envelope, and sends nothing until the commit.

actions.label: Pan pitch axis
actions.description: Analog pitch rate, -1..1. Positive = up. Live, this is the camera's pan rate at up to its max pan speed; above the staged delay threshold it turns the staged pitch wheel at up to 30 degrees per second, clamped to the camera's pitch envelope, and sends nothing until the commit. A camera with no pitch envelope does not move either way.
